info.name: Refund approval missing from audit log
info.description: One sampled refund lacked its approval event.
info.remediation: Record the approval decision and its request ID.

info.name: Audit archive below retention target
info.description: The retained sample covered only 30 of the required 90 days.
info.remediation: Align the archive retention setting with policy.

info.name: Access review has no named owner
info.description: The sampled access review lacked a sign-off owner.
info.remediation: Assign the control owner and record sign-off.

info.name: Internal build label in response header
info.description: The response sample included an internal build label.
info.remediation: Omit the build label from public responses.

info.name: Retired worker still listed in inventory
info.description: The inventory snapshot includes a retired worker.
info.remediation: Reconcile the entry with the decommission record.
